extracted.intended_audience: Users of GAP / computational group theorists running subgroup and cohomology computations
extracted.subtask_description: API reference and usage guidance for GAP functions and attributes related to subgroups, subgroup lattices, 1-cohomology, generating sets, and Schur covers; includes behavior, options, guarantees and performance notes for each routine.

rubrics_metrics.name: IntermediateGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Tries to find a subgroup E of G such that G > E > U; if U is maximal in G the function returns fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is done by finding minimal blocks for the operation of G on the right cosets of U; no additional guarantees beyond returning such an E or fail if none exists.

rubrics_metrics.name: IntermediateSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a list of all subgroups of G that properly contain U (all subgroups between G and U).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a record with component 'subgroups' (the list) and component 'inclusions' listing maximality inclusions among these subgroups; a maximality inclusion is given as [i,j] indicating subgroup i is maximal in subgroup j; numbers 0 and 1+Length(subgroups) denote U and G respectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: StructuralSeriesOfGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: The structural series of a finite group G is a descending series of characteristic subgroups which goes through the derived series of the solvable radical of G, refined into elementary abelian factors, as well as the socle and the Pker of the radical factor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as an attribute; example shows List(StructuralSeriesOfGroup(gp),Size) producing sizes of terms. Intended to give a canonical characteristic refinement including socle and Pker.

rubrics_metrics.name: NaturalHomomorphismByNormalSubgroup / NaturalHomomorphismByNormalSubgroupNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a homomorphism from G to another group whose kernel is N; NC variant does not check whether N is normal in G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GAP will try to select the image group to make computations efficient. The homomorphism returned is not necessarily surjective, so use ImagesSource instead of Range to get a group isomorphic to G/N. NC skips normality check.

rubrics_metrics.name: FactorGroup / FactorGroupNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the image of NaturalHomomorphismByNormalSubgroup(G,N); NC version does not test whether N is normal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided for compatibility with older code; if a connection between group and factor is desired, users should obtain the NaturalHomomorphismByNormalSubgroup first rather than just FactorGroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: CommutatorFactorGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the commutator factor group G / G'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple wrapper/operation to compute abelianization as a factor group; example shows call and output.

rubrics_metrics.name: MaximalAbelianQuotient
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an epimorphism from G onto the maximal abelian quotient of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The kernel of this epimorphism is the derived subgroup of G (see DerivedSubgroup). Provided as an attribute.

rubrics_metrics.name: HasAbelianFactorGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether G / N is abelian without explicitly constructing the factor group and without testing whether N is in fact a normal subgroup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fast test that avoids constructing factor group; example demonstrates boolean result. Does not verify N's normality—semantics assume quotient makes sense for test.

rubrics_metrics.name: HasElementaryAbelianFactorGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether G / N is elementary abelian without explicitly constructing the factor group and without testing whether N is in fact a normal subgroup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analogous to HasAbelianFactorGroup but checks for elementary abelian structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: CentralizerModulo
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the full preimage of the centralizer CG/N (elm·N) in G without necessarily constructing the factor group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to avoid building factor groups; example shows call and returned subgroup generators.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugacyClassSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Generates the conjugacy class of subgroups of G with representative U; returned as an external set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Functions such as Representative, ActingDomain, StabilizerOfExternalSet, and AsList work on it. Note: using [] list access to select elements of the class is obsolescent; use ClassElementLattice instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsConjugacyClassSubgroupsRep / IsConjugacyClassSubgroupsByStabilizerRep
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes the representation GAP uses for conjugacy classes of subgroups; second representation indicates an external orbit by stabilizer and will compute elements via a transversal of the stabilizer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these predicates to check which internal representation is used for a class of subgroups; affects how elements are enumerated/computed.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugacyClassesSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning a list of all conjugacy classes of subgroups of G (also applicable for subgroup lattices).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Order of classes depends on method chosen by GAP; Representative can access a class representative.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugacyClassesMaximalSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the conjugacy classes of maximal subgroups of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Representatives of classes can be computed by MaximalSubgroupClassReps; examples demonstrate typical outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: MaximalSubgroupClassReps
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a list of conjugacy representatives of the maximal subgroups of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directly gives representative subgroups for maximal conjugacy classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: LowIndexSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes representatives of the conjugacy classes of subgroups of G that have index less than or equal to a given index.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For finitely presented groups this defaults to LowIndexSubgroupsFpGroup; otherwise uses repeated calculation of maximal subgroups. Use LowLayerSubgroups to consider depth instead of index.

rubrics_metrics.name: AllSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: For a finite group G, returns a list of all subgroups of G (intended primarily for small examples).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List can become very long; ConjugacyClassesSubgroups is recommended for general use to avoid explosion.

rubrics_metrics.name: MaximalSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a list of all maximal subgroups of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May require much space; command should be avoided when possible. Use ConjugacyClassesMaximalSubgroups or MaximalSubgroupClassReps where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: NormalSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a list of all normal subgroups of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Algorithm described in [Hul98]; example outputs shown; can be expensive for large groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: MaximalNormalSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns proper normal subgroups of G that are maximal among the proper normal subgroups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives an error if G/G' is infinite (infinitely many maximal normal subgroups). If character table is known or G known to be abelian or solvable, computing those first can be more efficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: MinimalNormalSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns nontrivial normal subgroups of G that are minimal among nontrivial normal subgroups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute returns list; example given for SymmetricGroup(4).

rubrics_metrics.name: CharacteristicSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a list of all characteristic subgroups of G (subgroups invariant under all automorphisms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute; examples demonstrate usage. May duplicate normal subgroup information in some groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: LatticeSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the lattice of subgroups of G; the lattice has conjugacy classes of subgroups as attribute and permits testing maximality/minimality relations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for lattice computations; can be large. Example shows object printing with class and subgroup counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: ClassElementLattice
rubrics_metrics.description: For a class C of subgroups obtained by a lattice computation, returns the n-th conjugate subgroup in the class.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AsList may give a different arrangement of class elements due to other installed methods; be careful about indexing conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: DotFileLatticeSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Produces a graphical representation of the subgroup lattice in .dot (GraphViz) format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subgroups are labelled 'i-j' where i is class number and j the number within class; normal subgroups are represented by a box. Use external GraphViz viewers or OmniGraffle (Mac) to display.

rubrics_metrics.name: MaximalSubgroupsLattice
rubrics_metrics.description: For a lattice 'lat' this attribute contains the maximal subgroup relations among the subgroups of the lattice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a list corresponding to ConjugacyClassesSubgroups(lat), each entry giving a list of maximal subgroups of the representative. Every maximal subgroup is indicated as [c,n] where n corresponds to ClassElementLattice indexing (not necessarily AsList ordering). See also MinimalSupergroupsLattice.

rubrics_metrics.name: MinimalSupergroupsLattice
rubrics_metrics.description: For a lattice 'lat' this attribute contains the minimal supergroup relations among subgroups of the lattice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Similar representation to MaximalSubgroupsLattice, using [c,n] pairs referring to ClassElementLattice indexing; useful to traverse inclusion upwards.

rubrics_metrics.name: LowLayerSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes representatives of conjugacy classes of subgroups obtainable as lim-fold iterated maximal subgroups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optional cond function filters returned subgroups (must return true for subgroup and intermediate overgroups); optional dosub function controls whether maximal subgroups are attempted (for performance); optional act group can choose representatives under action of containing group.

rubrics_metrics.name: ContainedConjugates
rubrics_metrics.description: For A, B ≤ G returns representatives of the A-conjugacy classes of subgroups that are conjugate to B under G, returning list of pairs [subgroup, conjugating element].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optional 'onlyone' argument true returns only one pair or fail; useful to find representatives of conjugate-containing relations.

rubrics_metrics.name: ContainingConjugates
rubrics_metrics.description: For A, B ≤ G returns all G-conjugates of A that contain B; returns list of pairs of subgroup and conjugating element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to find overgroups of a given subgroup up to conjugacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: MinimalFaithfulPermutationDegree / MinimalFaithfulPermutationRepresentation
rubrics_metrics.description: MinimalFaithfulPermutationDegree computes the least positive integer n such that G embeds in S_n; MinimalFaithfulPermutationRepresentation returns a corresponding isomorphism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Computation can require calculating whole subgroup lattice; example shows usage and result. May be expensive for large groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: RepresentativesPerfectSubgroups / RepresentativesSimpleSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a list of conjugacy representatives of perfect (respectively simple) subgroups of G using the library of perfect groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Will issue an error if the library is insufficient to determine all perfect subgroups; relies on external database/package (PerfectGroup).

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugacyClassesPerfectSubgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns conjugacy classes of perfect subgroups of G (uses RepresentativesPerfectSubgroups).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides representatives and sizes; examples show how to list structure descriptions and sorted size lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zuppos
rubrics_metrics.description: The Zuppos of a group are the cyclic subgroups of prime power order; attribute gives generators of all such subgroups of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns all elements of G of prime power order up to equivalence generating the same cyclic subgroup; 'Zuppo' derives from German abbreviation.

rubrics_metrics.name: InfoLattice
rubrics_metrics.description: The information class used by the cyclic extension methods for subgroup lattice calculations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An info class for controlling/logging lattice cyclic extension algorithm; used by LatticeByCyclicExtension family of methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: LatticeByCyclicExtension
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the lattice of G using the cyclic extension algorithm; optional func restricts computed subgroups (returns partial lattice).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If func is given it discards subgroups not fulfilling func and will not extend them; trivial subgroup always included. If func is a list of length 2, first is discarding func, second is for discarding zuppos. Algorithm requires perfect subgroups; if func implies solvability, pass noperf=true to avoid computing perfect subgroups. Note: filtered partial lattice may not contain all subgroups that fulfill func because extension requires parent subgroups to also fulfill func; maximality/minimality relations cannot be computed for partial lattices.

rubrics_metrics.name: InvariantSubgroupsElementaryAbelianGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an elementary abelian group G and homs (automorphisms), computes all subspaces of G invariant under all automorphisms in homs (i.e., all submodules for the algebra generated by homs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If homs is empty computes all subgroups; optional dims parameter restricts to submodules of given dimension. Works by linear-algebraic subspace computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: SubgroupsSolvableGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes subgroups of a solvable group G using the homomorphism principle; returns representatives up to G-conjugacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optional 'opt' record accepts components: actions (list of automorphisms – only invariant groups returned; requires funcnorm or will compute normalizer), normal (true => only normal subgroups are guaranteed to be returned though false positives possible), consider (a five-argument function used to restrict computation at factor levels), retnorm (if true returns [subs,norms]), series (elementary abelian series to use), groups (seed groups). Restrictions are intended to speed up calculation and may yield false positives; function guarantees representatives of all subgroups that satisfy the properties (no false negatives). The consider function operates on factor groups and may not directly relate to G; use explicit tests after computation if strict filtering is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: SizeConsiderFunction
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a consider-function suitable for SubgroupsSolvableGroup option 'consider' that filters groups whose sizes are divisible by a given integer size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to speed computation; not a perfect filter—guaranteed that all subgroups fulfilling the condition are returned but not that all returned subgroups fulfill it (false positives possible). Example shows effect on returned subgroup sizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExactSizeConsiderFunction
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a consider-function for SubgroupsSolvableGroup that attempts to restrict computed subgroups to those of exactly a given size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same caveat as SizeConsiderFunction: consider does not provide a perfect filter; guarantees coverage of all subgroups matching the condition but may include others.

rubrics_metrics.name: InfoPcSubgroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Information function (info class) for the subgroup lattice functions using pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to control/log operations when pcgs-based subgroup lattice methods are applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsSmallest
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a 'smallest' generating set for G: the lexicographically smallest list l of elements such that G = <l> and each li not in <l1,...,li-1> (in particular l1 is not identity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lexicographic comparison uses GAP's order of group elements; the comparison of groups via lexicographic comparison of their sorted element lists yields the same relation as lexicographic comparison of their smallest generating sets.

rubrics_metrics.name: LargestElementGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the largest element of G with respect to the ordering < of the elements family.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple utility attribute relying on GAP's ordering of group elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: MinimalGeneratingSet
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a generating set of G of minimal possible length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only methods for finite groups, solvable groups, or finitely generated nilpotent groups are available (latter via Polycyclic package); computations for nonsolvable finite groups of higher rank can be expensive. If an optimal minimal set is not required, consider SmallGeneratingSet for faster result.

rubrics_metrics.name: SmallGeneratingSet
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a generating set of G which has few elements; runs much faster than MinimalGeneratingSet but does not guarantee irredundancy or minimal length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when a short generating set suffices and optimality is not required.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndependentGeneratorsOfAbelianGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns generators a1,a2,... of prime power order or infinite order of abelian group A such that A is the direct product of cyclic groups generated by the ai; the list of orders matches AbelianInvariants (accounting for zero/infinity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for canonical decompositions of abelian groups; ensures returned generators correspond to invariants.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndependentGeneratorExponents
rubrics_metrics.description: For an abelian group G with IndependentGeneratorsOfAbelianGroup value [a1,...,an], returns exponent vector [e1,...,en] representing g = product ai^ei.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Utility to convert elements into exponent coordinates relative to independent generators; example shows usage and matching to AbelianInvariants.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1-Cohomology: Z1 and B1 definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines Z1(G/M, M) as group of 1-cocycles and B1(G/M, M) as group of 1-coboundaries; both are GF(p)-vector spaces when M is elementary abelian normal p-subgroup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives explicit cocycle and coboundary equations and notes existence of monomorphism beta embedding Z1 into l-fold direct sum of row space W using chosen generators of G/M; conceptual background used by computational routines.

rubrics_metrics.name: OneCocycles / OneCoboundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the group of 1-cocycles Z1(G/M,M) or group of 1-coboundaries B1(G/M,M); accepts variants where group/module given by pcgs or by generator representatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a record with components: generators (representatives for generating set of G/M), oneCocycles (row vector space representing Z1), oneCoboundaries (row vector space representing B1), cocycleToList, listToCocycle, isSplitExtension, and if split: complement, cocycleToComplement, complementToCocycle, complementGens, factorGens. Note cocycle/coboundary spaces are vector spaces (not GAP Group objects). Special methods handle modulo pcgs inputs and compute presentations implicitly when needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: OCOneCocycles
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical function to compute 1-cocycles taking a record 'ocr' with at least 'group' and 'modulePcgs'; returns similar record to OneCocycles; if onlySplit true returns false early if extension does not split.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to short-circuit computation when only detecting splitting is required; oneCoboundaries may only be computed if not already present in input record.

rubrics_metrics.name: ComplementClassesRepresentativesEA
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes complement classes to an elementary abelian normal subgroup N via 1-cohomology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Normally users should call ComplementClassesRepresentatives (more general) which also handles solvable N. This routine is specialized to elementary abelian modules and uses 1-cohomology machinery.

rubrics_metrics.name: InfoCoh
rubrics_metrics.description: The info class for cohomology calculations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to control information output/logging during cohomology computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schur cover / EpimorphismSchurCover
rubrics_metrics.description: EpimorphismSchurCover(G[,pl]) returns an epimorphism epi from a Schur cover D onto G; kernel is Schur multiplier; optionally realize only multiplier part for primes in 'pl'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: D is represented as a finitely presented group. Use EpimorphismSchurCover when relation to G is needed; computing Schur covers can become unfeasible for large groups; AbelianInvariantsMultiplier may be used to get only structure of Schur multiplier for larger groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: SchurCover
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns one Schur cover of group G (represented as a finitely presented group).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If permutation representation is needed, apply IsomorphismPermGroup; use EpimorphismSchurCover if you need explicit epimorphism relating cover to G.

rubrics_metrics.name: AbelianInvariantsMultiplier
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the abelian invariants (structure) of the Schur multiplier of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the structure of the multiplier and is intended to work for larger groups where full Schur cover computations might be infeasible.
